title: Look up a key
summary: Go: Look up a key. Add Ravi with 5 pencils.
introduction: A map links a key to a value. The key below is a name and the value is a count.
learningObjectives: Look up a key with Go

blocks.text: Install Go 1.22 or later. Save one complete example as lesson.go and run go run lesson.go.

blocks.title: Look up a key

blocks.text: The Asha key maps to 3. A lookup returns the value, not its label.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Check the second lookup result when you need to know if a key exists.
